hero.title: Where Innovation Meets Curiosity
hero.subtitle: Empowering young minds through hands-on STEM education in Dhaka. Join us in exploring the exciting world of robotics, automation, and innovation.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.p1: Founded in 2022, {name} delivers engaging STEM education through real-world projects.
whoWeAre.p2: We help students turn curiosity into confidence, providing hands-on learning experiences that prepare them for future challenges in technology and engineering.

achievements.title: Our Achievements & Impact
achievements.subtitle: Celebrating milestones and student success
achievements.successBody: Our students have gone on to win national robotics competitions, secure scholarships, and pursue careers in engineering and technology. Many have represented Bangladesh in international robotics olympiads.
achievements.communityBody: We've partnered with schools across Dhaka to bring robotics education to underserved communities, organizing free workshops and providing resources to students who might not otherwise have access to STEM education.
